notes.meaning: David waited with endurance for God's help through a long season of distress. The Lord leaned down close, heard his desperate cry, and answered him. Patient waiting on God is never wasted time.

God pulled the psalmist out of a muddy pit of destruction where there was no place to stand. The Lord set his feet on solid rock, making his steps secure and safe. God can lift anyone from the darkest pit into lasting peace.

Deliverance gave the psalmist a fresh song of praise to worship God. Seeing this rescue leads many other people to respect the Lord and put their trust in Him. Our stories of God's goodness can guide others to faith.

True joy belongs to the person who trusts only in the Lord. Such a believer refuses to admire arrogant people or follow empty lies and false gods. Staying faithful to God protects us from worldly deception.

God has done countless miraculous works and formed loving plans for His people. No one can compare to Him, and His mercies are too numerous to list. We can rest in the knowledge that God's good thoughts toward us never stop.

Animal offerings and ritual gifts could never truly satisfy God or wash away sin. Instead, God opened the speaker's ears to give willing, wholehearted obedience to His commands. This points ahead to Jesus Christ, whose perfect obedience replaced all animal sacrifices.

Seeing that animal sacrifices were not enough, the speaker gladly stepped forward, saying, 'Here I am.' His coming had already been recorded in the scroll of the Scriptures. Jesus fulfilled this by willingly coming into the world to save us.

Doing God's will was not a heavy burden to the speaker, but his greatest delight. God's law was not just written on stone, but lived deep within his heart. Jesus showed us what perfect obedience looks like by gladly choosing the Father's will even to the cross.

The speaker openly announced God's saving righteousness to the whole assembly of God's people. He refused to stay quiet out of fear or embarrassment. Jesus likewise spent His ministry openly preaching good news to all who would listen.

God's faithfulness, love, and salvation were not kept as private secrets. The psalmist shared them freely with the entire congregation. When God rescues us, we are called to tell others about His goodness.

The psalm turns from praise to an urgent plea for God's mercy and protection. Because the speaker did not hide God's truth, he asks that God's loving kindness continue to guard him. We always need God's steadfast love to keep us safe from harm.

Countless troubles surrounded the speaker, and his sins caught up with him until he could not even lift his head. His heart lost courage under this terrible weight. When applied to Christ, this pictures Him bearing the heavy load of our sins as our substitute.
In deep trouble, the psalmist asks God to be pleased to rescue him quickly. He knows that his only hope lies in God's immediate help. We can bring our urgent needs to God with complete honesty.

other.label: Modern scholarship
other.view: Many modern scholars view verses 13–17 as a separate poem that was attached here, since it appears almost word-for-word elsewhere as Psalm 70.

notes.meaning: The psalmist prays that enemies who want to kill him will be disgraced and driven back. God's justice ensures that evil plots against His people will ultimately fail. Through Christ, all the powers of darkness have suffered defeat.

Wicked enemies mocked the sufferer, shouting words of cruel triumph over his trouble. The prayer asks that their hateful taunts turn into shame and shock upon their own heads. God protects His suffering children from the cruelty of mockers.

While the wicked face shame, those who seek God are blessed with joy and gladness. People who love God's salvation continually praise Him and make His name great. Seeking God always leads to real and lasting joy.

The psalm closes with an honest admission of weakness and poverty. Even so, the psalmist rejoices because the Lord is actively thinking about him and caring for his needs. Knowing God remembers us brings quiet peace even while we wait for His help.
